source_snapshot.procedure: Apply six EDKII debug/error-injection settings, deploy Intel ITP, boot the SUT into Windows, execute Intel CScripts from a client, log, halt, call injectUpiError(socket, port, num_crcs=1, cleanErrors=yes), then resume.
source_snapshot.criteria: System runs normally, BMC logs the UPI error, the front-panel fault light remains off if present, and OS dmesg reports the matching error.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek preserves the proprietary injector dependency and risk, but its post-check uses insecure SSH and truncated grep/tail evidence, does not resolve Windows versus dmesg, and does not define the Socket 0~N/port matrix.

original_test_intent.purpose: Inject one approved Intel UPI CRC error on every socket/UPI-port tuple required by the owner Socket 0~N matrix, then verify normal operation, the expected BMC error record, no front-panel fault-light assertion and the matching OS hardware-error evidence.
original_test_intent.target: The exact multi-socket Intel SUT and every owner-mapped source socket, UPI port/link and peer required by the recipe; `socket` and `port` are topology parameters, not generic indices.
original_test_intent.scope: Six specified BIOS debug/error-injection settings, Intel ITP/CScripts client setup, the recipe-defined Socket 0~N target matrix with `num_crcs=1` per approved invocation, complete harness/system/BMC/physical-indicator evidence, normal-operation verification and restoration of debug settings. It is not one arbitrary system-wide injection.
original_test_intent.operation: Preserve baseline settings/logs, apply the exact BIOS setup with operator approval, boot the owner-resolved supported OS, attach the controlled ITP client, then for each approved socket/port tuple capture a unique log, halt the correct target, inject one CRC with understood cleanup semantics, resume promptly, collect complete evidence and stop before another tuple if health or expected behavior is wrong. Restore debug settings after the approved matrix.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The source estimates 15 attended and 5 machine minutes but does not define socket count N, ports per socket, per-tuple delay or recovery timeout. `num_crcs=1` defines one CRC per invocation, not one total invocation; the approved topology matrix defines iteration count.
original_test_intent.expected_result: For every required tuple, the correct UPI CRC path is identified in complete harness and BMC evidence, the owner-selected OS records the matching hardware error through its native mechanism, the system remains operational as specified, and the front-panel fault light stays off. BIOS/debug and platform health return to the signed final state.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT/CPU/socket/UPI topology and tuple matrix; firmware/BIOS/BMC/OS/client/tool identities and hashes; baseline/export/clear audit; six BIOS settings before/during/after; exact per-tuple command and ITP logs; halt/inject/resume timestamps/status; complete native OS hardware-error record and BMC SEL; front-panel observation; health/recovery; restoration and final state.
ambiguities: The source instructs Windows boot but requires `dmesg`, a Linux kernel-log interface; the authoritative OS and native evidence path conflict.
Socket count N, eligible UPI ports/links, peer direction and required tuple matrix are absent.
Intel Cscripts/ITP versions, `cleanErrors=yes` semantics, expected record signatures and per-tuple delay/timeout are absent.
The source requests log clearing without defining baseline export/authorization, and the final state of six debug/injection BIOS settings is not specified.
source_conflicts: Procedure: boot the SUT into Windows. Criteria: check OS dmesg. Windows WHEA events are recorded through Windows event channels, whereas dmesg is a Linux kernel log; one OS-specific execution cannot satisfy both as written.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly keeps the critical proprietary injection as REQUIRES, demands a dedicated SUT, exact script, topology, operator, recovery, full evidence and BIOS restoration. It does not flag the Windows-versus-dmesg source conflict and describes one controlled injection without distinguishing one CRC per approved socket/port tuple from one total run.

applicable_history.decision: The exact row-specific V2 entry is the one-CRC UPI case. Adjacent records with the same title cover infinite CRC, data-lane failover, link-layer, Three-Strike, MCERR, IERR and I3C; none may be imported into this source row.
Conflicting source OS/evidence requirements must be marked SOURCE_CONFLICT and resolved rather than merged; target matrices and fault-injection parameters must not be inferred.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep REQUIRES but stop execution until the owner resolves Windows/WHEA versus Linux/dmesg and supplies the exact Socket 0~N UPI tuple matrix. Preserve one CRC per approved invocation, full per-tuple evidence, the front-panel negative criterion and critical halt/resume recovery.

available_now: The six BIOS settings, ITP/Cscripts control flow, one-CRC argument and four high-level acceptance obligations are explicit.
Read-only platform/topology/tool identity, BIOS baseline, current logs, front-panel state and recovery readiness can be collected before unlock or injection.
missing_inputs: The Intel/board RAS owner must resolve the supported SUT OS and native error evidence: Windows WHEA/ETW/Event Log or Linux dmesg/RAS path, with exact expected signature.

The Intel/FAE owner must supply the supported ITP/Cscripts build/hash, exact API semantics, client connection, Socket 0~N socket/port/link/peer matrix, one-way/bidirectional coverage and `cleanErrors` behavior.

The platform/lab owner must supply BIOS-state backup/restoration, approved baseline-log method, per-tuple delay/timeout, normal-operation criteria, LED observation, dedicated window, emergency resume/recovery and authorization.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The platform/RAS owner resolves OS evidence and acceptance; Intel/FAE supplies topology-aware proprietary injection artifacts; the lab owner supplies BIOS/physical execution, isolation, authorization and recovery.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Record CPU/socket/UPI link topology, firmware/BIOS/BMC/OS and client/tool identity, current six BIOS values, current system/BMC logs, front-panel state and console/OOB reachability without changing settings or clearing evidence.
Validate and sign a proposed socket/port/link/peer matrix against platform documentation and inspect the Cscript package/API offline without attaching, halting or injecting.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not mix Windows WHEA with Linux dmesg evidence, infer N/ports/peers, reuse adjacent infinite/failover/link-layer/catastrophic recipes, disable BIOS locks, attach ITP, halt/go, inject, clear logs, use insecure/truncated collection, auto-iterate sockets or restore/reset before preserving fault evidence.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Owner signs one OS/evidence path, exact tuple matrix and expected records; FAE signs tool/API and cleanup semantics; lab signs BIOS changes, per-tuple stops and emergency resume/recovery. Prove complete capture and restoration, then execute one CRC per tuple sequentially with a go/no-go review after each.

revision_candidate.test_name: Intel UPI Single-CRC Injection Across Approved Socket/Port Matrix
revision_candidate.purpose: Inject one approved UPI CRC error on each required socket/port tuple and verify native OS and BMC reporting, continued normal operation and no front-panel fault-light assertion.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact supported multi-socket Intel platform, BIOS/BMC/firmware, owner-resolved Windows WHEA or Linux RAS environment, controlled Intel ITP/Cscripts client and dedicated recovery-capable SUT.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every tuple in the owner-approved Socket 0~N source-socket, UPI-port/link and peer matrix; one `num_crcs=1` invocation per tuple, sequentially with a health gate. Do not include neighboring infinite CRC, failover, link-layer, Three-Strike, MCERR, IERR or I3C cases. Treat 15/5 minutes as estimates only.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Platform/firmware identity; socket/UPI topology and tuple/direction matrix; supported OS and native evidence decision; six BIOS values and restore plan; ITP/Cscripts build/hash/API/client map; exact command and `cleanErrors` semantics; expected harness/OS/BMC records; LED and normal-operation rule; per-tuple delay/timeout; log policy; approvals; emergency resume/recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Export and hash complete native OS/BMC logs before an approved clear, or use an approved timestamp marker. An operator applies and records the six exact BIOS settings and boots the single owner-selected OS. Validate ITP attachment from the controlled client. For each approved tuple, open a unique full log, verify target, halt, call the exact approved one-CRC injection, resume and verify resume immediately; collect unfiltered harness, native OS and BMC evidence plus physical LED/health before authorizing the next tuple. After all approved tuples, restore BIOS debug settings through the signed procedure and verify final boot/health.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Windows/dmesg conflict resolved; exact SUT/socket/port/link/peer matrix and expected records signed; supported tool/API and OS ready; dedicated idle SUT; baseline/settings backed up; authenticated evidence paths, clocks/storage, front-panel observer, console/OOB, emergency resume and recovery proven; operator/FAE/injection/reset approvals recorded.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Identity/version/hash and signed matrix/OS decision; complete BIOS before/during/after captures; baseline export/marker and clear audit; per-tuple unique ITP log, exact parameters, halt/inject/go timestamps and status; complete owner-selected OS hardware-error records; BMC SEL/raw event details; front-panel photos/observation showing no fault light; continuous health; abort/recovery; restored settings and final boot.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The FAE/platform-approved single-CRC UPI recipe and expected record matrix for the exact CPU/firmware/OS. Source criteria additionally require normal operation, BMC UPI detection, front-panel fault light off and matching native OS error evidence after the Windows/dmesg conflict is resolved.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Critical fault injection on a dedicated SUT only. Do not guess indices/ports, mix OS evidence, use another row's pattern, alter extra BIOS state, expose secrets, truncate/filter raw evidence, leave the target halted, continue after unexpected behavior, auto-loop, clear unexported logs or perform unapproved reset/restoration/rerun.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: FAE and platform-owner approval is required for tool/build/API, every tuple, BIOS unlocks, log clear, halt/injection/resume and expected evidence. A qualified operator handles BIOS and front-panel observation; each next tuple requires the signed go/no-go rule; restoration/recovery requires explicit authorization.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Operator/FAE configures BIOS, controls proprietary ITP attachment/injection and observes the front panel. Automation may inventory, preserve full logs and correlate supplied harness, native OS and BMC evidence; owner resolves OS/tool semantics and final result.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On target ambiguity, halt/resume failure, crash/hang, error storm or evidence/health mismatch, issue only the pre-approved emergency resume/abort, preserve client/console/OS/BMC state, use approved OOB recovery, do not proceed to another tuple, and restore BIOS settings only after the FAE reviews the evidence.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved Windows/dmesg conflict; wrong/ambiguous socket-port-peer tuple, tool/API/BIOS/OS mismatch; missing approval/recovery/evidence path; failed baseline preservation; target fails to resume; unexpected crash/reset/hang, UPI/RAS event or fault-light assertion; missing/mismatched OS or BMC record; thermal/power/health anomaly; cleanup ambiguity; or failed BIOS restoration/final boot.

identified_defects: The source requires Windows execution but Linux `dmesg` acceptance evidence.
DeepSeek uses insecure SSH, truncates/filters evidence and cannot prove the correct UPI tuple or native Windows record.
V2 does not mark the OS evidence conflict and can be read as one total injection despite Socket 0~N and socket/port parameters.
The source omits N, port/link/peer direction matrix, Cscripts version/API semantics, per-tuple timing and expected exact records.
Adjacent same-title RAS variants create a high risk of importing a different injection pattern if source_ref is ignored.
reason_for_change: Prevent mixed-OS evidence, partial socket coverage and wrong neighboring fault patterns in a critical halt/inject/resume workflow while preserving every explicit source criterion and one-CRC semantics.

new_technical_evidence.title: Querying the System Event Log for Hardware Error Events
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Windows execution path named by the source
new_technical_evidence.supports: Windows WHEA hardware errors are queried from Windows Event Log providers, so a Windows run requires owner-defined WHEA/Event Log or ETW evidence rather than a Linux dmesg command.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The expected UPI record/provider/event fields for this platform are not supplied.

new_technical_evidence.title: Registering for Notification of Hardware Error Events
new_technical_evidence.supports: Microsoft documents the `Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-WHEA/Errors` channel as the detailed server-oriented CPER path, reinforcing that the owner must specify the Windows-native evidence and fields.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: This does not define Intel proprietary injection targeting or the testcase's expected signature.

removed_ambiguities: Raises the Windows-versus-dmesg contradiction as SOURCE_CONFLICT instead of silently collecting both OS formats.
Defines one CRC per approved socket/port/link tuple and rejects one arbitrary injection as Socket 0~N coverage.
Makes halt/resume proof, front-panel negative evidence and post-matrix BIOS restoration explicit.
resolved_blockers: The proprietary/manual dependency remains technically executable after FAE handoff, so the capability class stays REQUIRES rather than BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: Execution is prohibited until the owner resolves OS/native evidence, supplies the complete topology tuple matrix and exact proprietary tool/record/cleanup semantics, and approves critical recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 exposes a real source contradiction, restores per-tuple Socket 0~N coverage and isolates the exact one-CRC variant, preventing false completion from one injection, Linux evidence on Windows or a neighboring critical RAS recipe.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The validator recovered the unresolved Windows-WHEA versus Linux-dmesg conflict, one CRC per signed socket/port/link/peer tuple, controlled-client ITP location, per-tuple halt/inject/resume/go-no-go evidence, front-panel negative criterion and final BIOS restoration. It excluded adjacent infinite/failover/link-layer/Three-Strike/MCERR/IERR/I3C patterns. The conflict is an underlying TEST_CASE_DOCUMENT_DEFECT; missing matrix/tool/approval data are PLATFORM_HANDOFF_DEFECT. Current execution gating does not change the REQUIRES capability class.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Reliability row 5 is the single-CRC `injectUpiError(socket, port, num_crcs=1, cleanErrors=yes)` variant, boots Windows, asks for dmesg, spans Socket 0~N and requires BMC error, normal operation and front-panel light off.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 adds strong critical-risk controls but misses the mixed-OS contradiction and does not make one-CRC-per-approved-tuple coverage explicit.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow read-only topology/tool/baseline work; prohibit BIOS unlock, ITP halt/injection/resume or log clear until the OS conflict, tuple matrix, exact script/evidence, approval and recovery are closed.
